No study of an employer's own personality and the wage they offer was found. HEXACO agreeableness for the UG proposer is .06 (k = 14). Dictator Game giving (no rejection threat) is stronger: FFM agreeableness .16 (k = 51), honesty-humility .26 (k = 43).

gap.class: counted households have no arrears of their own
gap.why: Runs each month for every full household with rent owed (src/core2/modules/housing.ts, review calls settleArrears and writes a `settlements` row per household and month; South Paris, Maine: 17 rows, 8 of them with a payment; Arroyo Hondo, New Mexico: 4 rows, none paid) and once when a counted household behind on rent is filled in. It does not run monthly for counted households: their rent is paid from a pool shared by place, and the pool repays its group's arrears every month before anything else (src/core2/counted-money.ts, chargeGroups asks rent plus the group's arrears), so there is no moment when a counted household holds cash and chooses between settling and letting it lapse. Households behind on rent seldom hold cash beyond a month's living, so most weighings paid nothing. Willingness is a share, so the general weight of 1 stands with no study.
gap.fix: Give counted households cash and arrears of their own (stopgap SG-WORLD-housing-counted-rent), then weigh them monthly like the full ones.
